equipmentTemplates.value: Practical traveling gear, a weapon suited to their background, and one thing they won't sell no matter how bad things get.
Whatever they could carry when they left, plus whatever they've picked up since.
A weapon, a scavenged kit, and enough scrap to trade for one more day.
A weapon, a charge cell running low, and a data-shard nobody's cracked yet.
A weapon, a phone with a cracked screen, and a photo they keep meaning to throw out.
A weapon, a candle stub, and a page torn from something they wish they hadn't read.

backgroundTemplates.value: {name} didn't set out to end up here, but here they are.
{name} has a past they don't talk about much, and a present they're still figuring out.
{name} came up the hard way, and it shows in how they handle themselves.
{name} was born after everything already fell apart, so this is just what normal looks like.
{name} grew up somewhere the newer maps don't bother naming anymore.
{name} had an ordinary life until it very suddenly wasn't.
{name} saw something once that they've never fully explained to anyone.

backstoryTemplates.value: {name} became a {className} after a decision that still doesn't feel fully settled, even now.
{name}'s path to being a {className} wasn't a straight line, and they'd be the first to admit it.
Whatever {name} expected out of life, being a {className} wasn't quite it -- but it fits, mostly.

flavorStatsTemplates.value: Capable in a fight when they need to be, better at avoiding one when they can.
Not the strongest in a room, but rarely the least prepared.
Leans on instinct and improvisation more than training.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled -- attributes/background are table-generated, derived stats (if this world uses a formula) are code-computed.
